usage: A common noun for a place where people go for rides, games, and entertainment. Use it as a normal thing/place noun, e.g. with verbs like 去 or 喺.
It is a neutral, everyday word. In Hong Kong speech, people also often say 主題樂園 when they want to emphasize a themed park.
Can be used with location or time expressions to say where someone goes or when a place opens, closes, or is crowded.
Learners should treat 遊樂園 as one fixed place name-like noun; it usually does not need extra measure words in simple sentences.
